title: Business Chat Platform
excerpt: A business chat web application that powers customer conversations at scale, shipped feature by feature.
description: A business communication platform that lets companies manage customer conversations across channels in one place. I develop and maintain the frontend, continuously shipping new features and fixes while improving performance and refining the system design for better scalability and maintainability. I collaborate on architecture decisions and own frontend features end to end, with an engineer's attention to detail and a focus on a fast, reliable real-time experience.

title: Fundex — Investment Fund Platform
excerpt: A fintech platform for browsing, managing, and investing in funds, built for clarity and data integrity.
description: Fundex is an investment-fund platform that lets users browse, manage, and invest in funds through a responsive, intuitive interface. I translated complex fintech requirements into clean, maintainable Vue and TypeScript components, with a strong focus on accuracy and data integrity across every flow. The result was a polished, trustworthy experience for managing fund investments, backed by a scalable codebase the team could keep building on.

title: Safety Monitor — AI Factory Safety System
excerpt: An AI-powered system that verifies in real time whether factory workers are wearing their required protective equipment.
description: Safety Monitor helps industrial facilities enforce workplace safety by using AI to verify that workers are equipped with required protective gear — helmets, vests, and more — across live camera feeds. I built the frontend in Vue 3 and TypeScript, turning a continuous stream of AI detection data into clear, real-time dashboards with interactive ApexCharts visualizations on a Vuetify-based interface. The system gave safety teams instant visibility into compliance and incidents, replacing manual spot-checks with automated, data-driven monitoring.
